Class RecordStartupProfile

java.lang.Object
org.gradle.api.internal.AbstractTask
org.gradle.api.DefaultTask
io.micronaut.runner.gradle.RecordStartupProfile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<org.gradle.api.Task>, org.gradle.api.internal.DynamicObjectAware, org.gradle.api.internal.TaskInternal, org.gradle.api.Named, org.gradle.api.plugins.ExtensionAware, org.gradle.api.Task, org.gradle.util.Configurable<org.gradle.api.Task>
@UntrackedTask(because="Launches the application") public abstract class RecordStartupProfile extends org.gradle.api.DefaultTask
Records the startup profile of the application: launches the runner jar, waits until it is ready, sends it the training workload and writes the classes it loaded to a file that is meant to be committed. The next build of the runner jar embeds the file, and the launcher preloads those classes on a background thread.

The task launches the application, so it is never up to date and never part of assemble, build or check: it runs only when it is asked for. Whether it succeeds, fails or is cancelled, the application and every process the application started are gone when it ends.

The API is experimental: it may change in any release.

Since:
1.0

      @InputFile @PathSensitive(NONE) public abstract org.gradle.api.file.RegularFileProperty getArchiveFile()
      The runner jar to record from. The plugin sets the archive of micronautRunnerJar, so the recording runs what production runs, with every default packaging transformation.
      Returns:
      the runner jar

      public abstract org.gradle.api.provider.Property<org.gradle.jvm.toolchain.JavaLauncher> getJavaLauncher()

      public abstract TrainingSpec getTraining()

    • getProfileFile

      @OutputFile public abstract org.gradle.api.file.RegularFileProperty getProfileFile()
      The profile to write. The plugin sets "src/main/micronaut-runner/startup-classes.txt" in the project directory, which is where the packaging tasks look for it.

    • getWorkDirectory

      @Internal public abstract org.gradle.api.file.DirectoryProperty getWorkDirectory()
      The working directory of the launch, which is emptied first. The application's output and the JVM's class-load log stay in it. The task takes only a new or empty directory, or one an earlier recording left, and never one that holds the runner jar or the profile: it fails rather than delete anything else.
      Returns:
      the work directory
